findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: Arabic falls back from Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: Arabic set too small
findings.fix: Keep Arabic UI text at 14px or more, and body text at 16px.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: left: -1px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: border-top-left-radius: 17px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
findings.snippet: مرحباً، طلبت تفعيل خدمة 5G على خطّي، لكن الشبكة ما زالت تقني. 10:12 ص
